title: Home calendar preview layout fixed to match the Classes page
summary: The Home widget version of the calendar preview was forced into display:flex/flex-direction:column while the Classes page renders the exact same markup with normal block layout and works correctly -- that forced flex-column was the actual cause of content overlapping in the Home widget. Reverted it to match Classes' layout; only the widget-specific background/padding stripping and scroll behavior remain Home-specific.
